d: Jet black hair is cut into a short, choppy bob with straight-cut bangs across the forehead. Sharp, narrow purple eyes are set into a youthful face with a stoic expression. The build is slender and athletic, clad in a black and gold armored outfit featuring a white chest piece, a yellow fabric waist tie, and a long, flowing white cloak with a purple lining. Signature details include two small purple horns protruding from the head and heavy black mechanical plating covering the legs and arms.
